headline: Approved June 4, 2026 minutes and held a community mapping activity to identify Wallingford resources and service gaps.
summary: The Mayor's Council approved the June 4, 2026 minutes. Eve Hein and Kara Sepulveda Fonrera from the Alliance for Prevention and Wellness led a Community Mapping Activity where attendees identified Wallingford resources and discussed basic needs like transportation and food insecurity, service gaps, and partnering with other community agencies.

decision_evidence.quote: June 4, 2026 Minutes were approved by Mayor's Council.

June 4, 2026 Minutes were approved by Mayor’s Council. 
Eve Hein and Kara Sepulveda Fonrera from the Alliance for Prevention and Wellness facilitated the 
Community Mapping Activity.  
The attendees were broken into two diƯerent groups to create a map of Wallingford. Each group 
identiﬁed resources and services that are available in Wallingford.  
Conversation was had around the theme of basic needs to include access to transportation and

Brainstorming on additional eƯorts to address gaps of services and care. Conversation was growth 
focused on identifying ways to support at-risk, or disengaged community members, in eƯorts to

Conversation was had around partnering with other community agencies to support the initiative.
